description_en: Creates a Tair AI Gateway instance
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore create-tair-ai-gateway-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-beijing-l --vswitch-id 'vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTairAIGatewayInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的可用区的ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the VPC. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html operation to query the vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 该专有网络下的虚拟交换机ID，可调用专有网络VPC的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html获取
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Only pay-as-you-go is supported. Valid values:
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，目前仅支持按量付费，取值：
PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Only pay-as-you-go is supported. Ignore this parameter.
The renewal period. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36.
For example, if an instance expires in three months and you renew it for three months, the instance will expire in six months after the renewal
parameters.help_zh:
目前仅支持按量付费，请忽略该参数。
续费的周期，单位为月，取值：1~9、12、24、36。
例如实例还有3个月到期，本次续费3个月，则本次续费后，实例还剩余6个月到期
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The activity ID and business information
parameters.help_zh: 活动ID、业务信息
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. Default value: default
parameters.help_zh: 优惠码，默认值为：`default`
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Only pay-as-you-go is supported. Ignore this parameter.
Specifies whether to use a voucher. Valid values:
true: uses a voucher.
false (default): does not use a voucher
parameters.help_zh:
目前仅支持按量付费，请忽略该参数。
是否使用代金券，取值：
true：使用代金券。
false（默认）：不使用代金券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en:
Only pay-as-you-go is supported. Ignore this parameter. Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false (default): disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
目前仅支持按量付费，请忽略该参数。是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false（默认）：不开启
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Only pay-as-you-go is supported. Ignore this parameter. The auto-renewal period. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.
This parameter is required when AutoRenew is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
目前仅支持按量付费，请忽略该参数。自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、6、12。
当AutoRenew取值为true时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Only pay-as-you-go is supported. Ignore this parameter. Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. The value is fixed to true
parameters.help_zh: 目前仅支持按量付费，请忽略该参数。自动支付，取值固定为true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The key of the label.

N specifies the sequence number of the label key. You can attach up to 20 labels to a single instance. For example, Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the first label, and Tag.2.Key specifies the key of the second label.
If the label key does not exist, automatic creation is performed
fields.help_zh:
标签的键。

N表示传入第几个标签的键，单个实例最多可绑定20个标签。例如Tag.1.Key表示传入第一个标签的键；Tag.2.Key表示传入第二个标签的键。
如果标签的键不存在，则自动创建
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.1.Value specifies the value of the first tag, and Tag.2.Value specifies the value of the second tag
fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如Tag.1.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.2.Value表示传入第二个标签的值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the instance creation request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without creating the instance. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and inventory. If the request fails the dry run, the system returns an error. If the request passes the dry run, the system returns the DryRunOperation error code.
false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the instance is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次创建实例的操作执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查操作，不创建实例。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The name of the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 网关备注名称
parameters.name: gateway_name

parameters.help_en: The specifications of the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 网关规格
parameters.name: gateway_type

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] Do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已弃用，请勿传入
parameters.name: plugin_type

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] Do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已弃用，请勿传入
parameters.name: plugin_params

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: VPC网络的ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

FailCount.description_en: The number of instances that fail to be created in a batch. This parameter is not returned when a single instance is created
FailCount.description_zh: 批量创建实例时的成功失败实例数。创建单个实例时不会返回该参数

NodeId.description_zh: 该参数已弃用。虚拟节点ID

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of instances that are successfully created in a batch. This parameter is not returned when a single instance is created
SuccessCount.description_zh: 批量创建实例时的成功创建实例数。创建单个实例时不会返回该参数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances created in a batch. This parameter is not returned when a single instance is created
TotalCount.description_zh: 批量创建实例时的总实例记录数。创建单个实例时不会返回该参数

VClusterId.description_zh: 该参数已弃用。虚拟集群ID

VkName.description_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. The instance ID of the VCluster virtual cluster where the VNode resides
VkName.description_zh: 该参数已弃用。VNode所在VCluster虚拟集群实例ID
